plan.rule: Every exact-source control from recency0914, no outcome filter. Reconstruct native PREDICT rankings from archived live snapshots; compare two prospectively specified masks for negative evidence. No games, no policy choice by prediction accuracy or reward.
plan.scoring: Keep every observed positive event and native matching/miss rules. Penalize an absent library event only if all three time points in its matching neighborhood were observable under the selected mask. Stable original-library tie order.

note: Repeated overlapping history windows are not independent evidence. Changed offline signals do not establish emitted action changes, accepted trades or competitive benefit.
